comment: The public roadmap. `bun nv site --check roadmap` keeps it in step with the goal chain, and `bun nv site --roadmap` copies it into README.md. `internal` lists the goals that are not public work.

themes.title: Mail that a web app needs
themes.text: `Core\Mail` sends attachments, images inside the HTML, styled HTML, sender names and replies in a thread, through every common mail server. A program can also read a mailbox over IMAP. It can tell whether a message is a bounce, an automatic reply or a reply to a mail it sent.

themes.title: One way to change your code safely
themes.text: Each refactoring, such as a rename or a file move, checks its change before it writes it. The same refactorings work from your editor and from the command line with `nvs code`.
